html:
Get the designer look with added security and privacy

Tinting your house windows is an excellent way of increasing privacy and security, while giving your home that designer look.

And with the warmer weather fast approaching in Perth, now’s the time to get your home tinted in time for the warmer seasons.

We at Tint a Car stock a range of house window films that could be applied to almost any window surface.

Our house window tinting range includes:

  • Designer Home Window Films – decorative window film that comes in a range of styles including frosted and opaque film choices. These films could be tailored using our special design service, with graphics, logos and other decorative elements to achieve a truly unique work of art for your home or office.
  • Anti-Graffiti Films – film that protects your home or office windows against graffiti. With its unique ability to be installed on marble, concrete or windows, preserve your surfaces from vandalism with ease. Saves you the expense of having to replace glass panels.
  • Solar Window Film – with up to 79% reduction in solar heat, 93% reduction in glare and 99% reduction of harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays, protecting your home and its contents has never been easier!

These are just some of the many films that the 100+ Tint a Car stores around the country stock.

Get expert advice

What’s more, our expert home window tinters are available for an obligation-free consultation to help you decide which film works best for your home and lifestyle. It’s no wonder why we are amongst the most preferred companies of home window tinting in Perth.

To talk through the best options for your house window tinting in Perth, find a store near you and our helpful and friendly staff will be happy to help you.
